translations.web: Will you even annul my judgment? Will you condemn me, that you may be justified?
translations.bsb: Would you really annul My justice? Would you condemn Me to justify yourself?
translations.kjv: Wilt thou also disannul my judgment? wilt thou condemn me, that thou mayest be righteous?
translations.asv: Wilt thou even annul my judgment? Wilt thou condemn me, that thou mayest be justified?
